text: Ellie has a second interview at the council on 2 November 2026. She's really nervous about the panel bit. Text her good luck the night before.
yuki lives in leeds now, works for an architecture firm near the station. her sister aiko is still in osaka
Emeka applied for the senior analyst role at Fischer & Co, hears back sometime next week

So I bumped into Kavya at the shops and she said her brother Varun is moving to Bristol at the end of the month, and he's starting a new job there in early December. She's a bit gutted because he's been living with her and her mum since the summer. I should ask her how the move goes.
Sophie's dad retires in March 2027 after thirty years at the post office. Big party planned.
Julien - interview Thurs, nervous, wants me to proofread his cover letter before then
Katarzyna works nights at the hospital. Two kids, Jakub and Olivia. Husband is a plumber.
Freya didn't get the Edinburgh job. Gutted but says she's fine. Check in with her sometime next week
pick up dry cleaning, renew car insurance before end of month
Eduardo and his wife are off to Lisbon over the summer for their anniversary, ten years. Maybe a card?
Keisha's interview at the bank went really well apparently, they said she'd hear by Friday. Need to message her Friday evening to see if she got it.
Joseph's mum had her hip op yesterday. He sounded tired. Ring him at the weekend.
Gabriel - Mateo's older brother - is the one who works at the football club, not Marcus. Marcus is the cousin in Manchester.

right so voice note, chatted to Sunil after work, he's applying for the deputy head post at his school, closing date is the 14th, interviews early January, and he said Deepa is due in February so the timing's a nightmare. He's not sleeping much. Should send him a bit of encouragement before the deadline
Matteo Reyes, the new guy in accounts, goes by Teo. Lives in Clapham with his girlfriend and a greyhound called Biscuit.
Nia's audition for the conservatoire is 12 February 2027. Remind me to text her the morning of.
Chris got the job!! Starts 3 November. Send congrats
Jin's grandma passed away last week. Funeral is sometime next week in Busan, he's flying out Sunday.
Beatriz mentioned she'd love a decent coffee grinder, hers broke. Her birthday's end of November.
Alfie's driving test was cancelled again because of the examiner strike. Rebooked for mid January.
dalia - vegan, allergic to nuts, works in UX at a startup in shoreditch
Georgia and Björn are getting married next August in Sweden! Engagement party at theirs on 7 November 2026.
Had coffee with Ellie. Her boyfriend Chris just had a phone screen with Google and she's more nervous than he is lol. Final round is sometime in the next fortnight.
Emily's moving into a new flat in Hackney on the 30th. Offered to help her carry boxes that morning.
ask Yuki how her PhD viva went
Aiko and her partner have a new puppy, Mochi. Their kids are obsessed.
Emeka's daughter starts nursery in January. His wife Kavya is back at work then too.

Kavya said her uncle is in hospital in Pune, kidney stuff. Her parents are flying out tomorrow and she's going early next month if he doesn't improve. She's holding it together but only just. Don't forget to check on her this weekend.
Sophie Lee works at the Natural History Museum, education team. Grew up in Cardiff. Brother is a paramedic.
Julien's leaving drinks Friday the 31st - he's off to the Paris office in the new year
Varun has the final interview for the Amazon role on Tuesday, then a presentation sometime the week after. Wish him luck Monday night and ask how it went after.
Katarzyna's son Jakub got into Manchester for medicine. Starts September 2027 after his gap year.
Note for future: Freya hates surprises, don't do anything for her 40th without asking Eduardo first
Keisha mentioned her mum's 70th is early March. They're thinking of a meal somewhere. She'd appreciate ideas.
Joseph - lives in Stockport, teaches maths at a sixth form college, coeliac, supports Stockport County
gabriel's new job at the hospital starts monday, he said the shifts are brutal
Mateo has an interview at Deloitte on 5 November 2026. Says it's a long shot. Must remember to ask him about it.
Marcus told me his brother-in-law got made redundant. Whole department went. He's helping him with his CV.
Sunil and Deepa are hosting Diwali at theirs on the 8th, I'm bringing dessert

Went for lunch with Nia and Chris. Nia's thinking of quitting her job to retrain as a nurse, might apply over the summer. Chris is supportive but worried about money. Their landlord is selling the flat too so they might have to move by March 2027. A lot going on for them. Should invite them round for dinner sometime next week.
Jin works at Samsung in Seoul, wife is Beatriz (Brazilian), they met in Lisbon. Two cats.
Beatriz's sister Dalia has a job interview at the embassy on Wednesday. Beatriz asked me to send her some tips on competency questions.
Jakub's exams are mid-May through June. Olivia's doing her GCSEs at the same time. Katarzyna is losing her mind.
Olivia's netball team made the county final, it's on 22 November
Alfie got the apprenticeship at the garage! Starts after Christmas.
Need to book dentist sometime next week and sort the boiler service before winter
Dalia's dad is the one who used to run the restaurant on Mill Road. Retired now, lives in Cyprus most of the year.
Georgia had her performance review today, says it went badly and she might be put on a plan. Call her tomorrow evening.
Björn Andersson - Georgia's fiancé - works for IKEA in procurement. Very into cycling, does the Vätternrundan every year.

ok so Ellie's sister Freya has her interview for the head of marketing job at the end of the month and Ellie says she's been prepping for weeks but she's still a wreck about it. Also their mum's birthday is the 2nd. I should get something small for their mum and text Freya good luck the day before.
Yuki Suzuki, recruiter at Hays, said she'll put me forward for the product manager role. First interview probably early November.
Aiko's son passed his driving test first time! Seventeen. She's terrified.
I'm applying for the Leeds job myself, deadline 15 November 2026. Need to update my portfolio this weekend.
Emily's partner Jin had his citizenship interview yesterday. Find out if he's heard anything.
Emeka's wedding anniversary is 19 December. He always forgets, maybe drop him a hint early December lol
Sophie's flatmate Kavya works at the same law firm as her, different team. They live above the bakery on Station Road.
Julien said his mum was diagnosed with diabetes over the summer. She's doing ok now. He's been driving down to Brighton most weekends.
Spoke to Varun briefly. Nothing new really, just football chat.
Deepa's baby shower is sometime mid January, Sunil's organising it as a surprise. Chip in for the group present.

Matteo's girlfriend Nia had her interview for the teaching assistant role on Monday. She thinks it went ok but they said four to six weeks. Check in with her at the end of the month if nothing's come through. She's been applying since spring and it's getting her down.
